note: Stage 11 dataset registry. Values are transcribed from the cited sources; nothing here is tuned. A null means the source does not state it and it is NOT filled in. 'envelope' lists sensitivity variants used for inputs the source does not give; they are not fits.

datasets.title: Sierra 175 gr MatchKing, .308 Win short barrel, live-fire drop to 1323 yd (Applied Ballistics ABDOC130 Table 1)
datasets.method: Observed drop = elevation needed to centre the group on a steel target; source states uncertainty of about +/-1 click (0.1 mil).

bullet.diamSource: caliber .308 stated in text; bullet diameter itself not printed

datasets.mvSource: text: 'average muzzle velocity of 2570 fps' (instrument not stated)

bc.origin: Litz value quoted in a third-party article; different lot and source

missing: whether drop is vs line of sight or bore (text says drop; 'relative to line of sight' is the reading used)
datasets.notCountedAsMeasured: Vel/Mach column and prediction column of the source table (custom drag curve output)

primary.reason: default app inputs fixed before looking at results; not a best fit

datasets.title: Berger 175 gr OTM Tactical, same test series (ABDOC130 Table 2)
datasets.excludedBecause: No muzzle velocity is stated for this table. Using DS-A's 2570 fps would be a guess, so no prediction is made.

datasets.title: Brozovich .338 Wildcat, 300 gr Berger Hybrid OTM, MV 3198 fps (ABDOC130 Table 3)
datasets.method: Caption says 'predicted and actual drop'; the method for the drop column is not described in the text read.
missing: whether the MOA values are measured
datasets.excludedBecause: It cannot be established from the source that the listed drops are measured rather than fitted or calculated, and the zero and atmosphere are missing. It is not counted as measured data.

datasets.title: Warner Flat Line 155 gr .30 cal, 1000 and 1220 yd, Precision Rifle Blog BC test
datasets.method: Scope elevation (mil) at which hits were observed at known (rangefinder) distances; at 1220 yd the hits were 8.4 (slightly low) and 8.5 (slightly high). Blog post, not a peer-reviewed test.

bullet.diamSource: nominal 30 caliber; exact diameter not printed (assumption: .308)

bc.origin: advertised by the maker (method not stated)

missing: atmosphere values (a Kestrel was used; readings not printed)
number of shots at each range

measured.uncertaintyNote: assumed one 0.1 mil click; not stated by the source

primary.reason: default app inputs fixed before looking at results; not a best fit

datasets.circularityNote: The post's own fitted G7 0.278 was derived from these same hits, so it is not used as an input.

datasets.title: Sniper's Hide forum report, Savage 110 6.5 Creedmoor, Hornady 140 ELD-M, 1000 yd
datasets.method: Forum post: 'actual elevation needed' 8.7 mrad at 1000 yd; method, targets and shot count not described. 42-shot MV session: avg 2750, ES 32, SD 9.1.
missing: atmosphere (barometer reading uncertain per the poster)

measured.uncertaintyNote: not stated; the poster's own calculator gave 8.24 mrad, a 0.46 mrad gap that the post attributes to unknown causes

primary.reason: stated sight height; standard atmosphere because none given

datasets.title: Courtney and Courtney Doppler-radar drag coefficients (arXiv 1608.06500), already in tests/validation/measured-doppler.json
datasets.method: LabRadar Doppler measurement of Cd over about the first 20-25 yd.
datasets.circularityNote: The BCs in the source are fitted from the same shots, so agreement tests the table's shape near one Mach number per shot, not trajectory prediction.
